svg.text: Pre-enlistment career compass · dodecahedron · warm gold dominant

g.text: Entry sequence
Camera flies through dodecahedron · 12 pentagonal faces illuminate in sequence
Faces rotate outward like petals · camera emerges into golden atmosphere
Audio: hub drone crossfades → ascending warm harmonics
Environment
Horizonless golden-hour atmosphere · no ground plane, no sky
Career pathway geometry: cyan line-work branching through warm space
Decision nodes as crystalline vertices · multiple futures radiating outward
Visual opposite of Gauntlet: light is alive, directional, warm
Lighting + atmosphere
Volumetric gold haze (#E8A030)
Ambient: warm, omnidirectional
Rim light: cyan on pathway geo
Bloom: high radius, warm tint
Audio signature
Ascending sine harmonics
Major 3rds, perfect 5ths
Warm pad foundation
Chime tones on UI hover
Glass-morphic UI overlay
ASVAB aptitude alignment wheel → aptitude clusters map to career families
Branch/MOS recommendation cards with civilian-equivalent roles
Career trajectory preview per path · interactive hover highlights
3D pathway threads pulse when corresponding UI card is hovered
Frosted glass panel · warm tint · ±3° parallax tilt on cursor
Return to NOVA
Pathway threads retract inward · golden haze dims
Camera reverses through dodecahedron · gold particles trail to hub
Audio crossfades back to 432Hz drone · NOVA core brightens

svg.text: Emotional register: optimistic, not triumphant · potential, not achievement
This is the only scene where nothing has happened yet — pure possibility
